title: The 10 Best Wood Chisel Sets
subtitle: Bevel-edge wood chisel sets for woodworking and carpentry, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A good set of chisels fits hinges, cleans out joints and pares wood to a line. We ranked 10 best-sellers from Narex, DEWALT, IRWIN, Amazon Basics, WORKPRO and value brands on rating, review volume and features (six or more chisels, strike caps, a sharpening kit and storage).

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

avoid.name: MECHEER 4-Piece Wood Chisel Set, 6, 12, 18 and 24 mm
avoid.flag: Unspecified carbon steel; invites metal-hammer pounding
avoid.verdict: A cheap set of plain carbon steel chisels with no heat treatment or hardness listed, sold as fine for heavy pounding with a metal hammer.
reasons: The blades are listed only as 'sturdy carbon steel'. Every other set we ranked names its heat treatment, hardness or alloy.
It says the chisels are 'suitable for heavy pounding with a metal hammer'. Bevel-edge chisels are made for paring and light chopping with a mallet, and heavy hammer blows chip thin edges.
Its 866 reviews are shared with MECHEER's 5-piece set. The HURRICANE set costs a few dollars more with heat-treated CR-V blades.

buyers_guide.a: 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 and 1 inch cover most work, from hinge mortises to cleaning out joints. Add 1-1/4 and 1-1/2 inch for wider paring.
Bevel-edge chisels like these are all-rounders for paring, trimming and light chopping. Mortise chisels are thicker for heavy chopping deep mortises.
Chrome-vanadium and chrome-manganese steels hardened to about HRC 58-62 hold a good edge and still sharpen easily. Harder steel holds an edge longer but is more brittle.

buyers_guide.q: Do I need to sharpen new chisels?
buyers_guide.a: Usually yes. Factory edges are rarely as sharp as they should be. Flatten the back and hone the bevel before use; sets with a stone and honing guide make this easy.
Use a wooden or rubber mallet on wood handles. Chisels with a steel strike cap can take a hammer for site work.
